description:
Gate declarations carry `auto`, a deprecated mirror of `mode` kept only for round trips, and `example_integration`. A stale key in an adopter's `gates.toml` loads silently.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/declarations/gates.rs:187-192` calls both fields "deprecated authored field preserved during round trips". `GateDefinition` (`gates.rs:153`) has no `deny_unknown_fields`, and `serialize_gate_registry` (`gates.rs:236`) always writes `auto`.

`auto` has no reader except the output mirror (`output.rs:2752`); automation reads `mode`. Writers derive it from `mode`: `gate_presets.rs:63-64`, `commands/gate.rs:635-636,1244-1245`.

`example_integration` is wired to `gate define --example` (`cli.rs:1368-1370`, `main.rs:4225,4305`), printed by `gate show` (`main.rs:4525-4527`), emitted in JSON (`output.rs:2731,2753`) and documented at `docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1924`.

Authored data carrying `auto`:

- 20 gates in `.jit/gates.toml`.
- Six gate contributions in `profiles/jit-dogfood/manifest.toml:143-239`, which `profile/repository_package.rs` checks against the live registry.

Projected reference: `docs/reference/gate-presets.md:18,62,75,88,102,116`, generated from `gate_presets/reference.rs:22-90,115` by `scripts/generate-gate-presets-reference.sh`. Other docs: `docs/how-to/adopt-planning-bracket.md:238,251,264`.

Rust literals that set the fields: `commands/gate_check.rs` tests, `commands/gate.rs` tests (`:1588-1777,2243`), `commands/mod.rs:3528-3546,3675`, `commands/issue.rs:887,986,1045,1282`, `output.rs:2978,3948-3989`, `commands/invariant.rs:99`, `repository_state/mod.rs:1471`, `repository_state/rules_gates_projection.rs:245`, `declarations/gates.rs:391`, `src/test_harness.rs:324` and `tests/fast_rules/project_render_harness_tests.rs:112`. `tests/cli_item_validate/registry_json_tests.rs:84,107` exercises `--example`.

TOML gate fixtures carrying `auto = true`, which fail to load once `GateDefinition` is strict: `storage/gate_store.rs:56,66`, `tests/cli_gate/gate_update_test.rs:70`, `tests/cli_gate/gate_evaluate_all_test.rs:105`, `tests/cli_item_validate/validate_cli_rule_tests.rs:624`, `tests/cli_gate/bracket_coverage_gate_run_test.rs:130` and `.agents/skills/jit-planning-lead/evals/setup-test-repo.sh:75`.

Prose: `dev/architecture/core-system-design.md:61` describes `example_integration`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GateDefinition` has no `auto` or `example_integration` field and rejects unknown fields, so a declaration carrying `auto` fails to load with an error naming it.
- [hard] REQ-02: Automation is read from `mode` alone, and no writer, serializer, output mirror or preset emits `auto`.
- [hard] REQ-03: `gate define --example`, the `gate show` example line and the JSON `example_integration` field no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-04: `.jit/gates.toml` and the `jit-dogfood` gate contributions carry no `auto` key, and the profile still matches the live registry.
- [hard] REQ-05: The generated gate-presets reference shows no `auto` key, and the planning-bracket how-to, the CLI reference and the core system design note describe neither field.
- [hard] REQ-06: No Rust literal, TOML fixture or evaluation setup script sets either field.

## Notes

The `gate define --auto` CLI flag is sugar for `--mode auto`, not a declaration field, and stays.
title: Remove the auto and example-integration gate fields
